cost_protocol.registration:
#652 cover-hop guard cost cohort, rerun on current main. Written before any tape ran.
Same protocol as the rejected v1 cohort: dm4, exactly 3 tapes per arm, 30 s, skill 2,
played rate (ticrate 0.0139), primary stall_parity, no extra tapes chosen by outcome.
Arms: control = frozen main 24a8de3 (backups/cover652/control-src); candidate = fix/cover-hop-guard.
Arms run side by side on ports 26031 and 26032.
Reject if the native band verdict rejects, which includes the severe-freeze veto
(any candidate under-fire freeze).

cost_reason: Native band verdict approves parity on stall_parity; no freezes in either arm. The card flags engagements (mean 14 to 9.7) while both medians are 11, inside the control band of 5 to 22.
